scheme_name: Annual Insurance Premium for Boat Owners
other_conditions: Must have resided in the Union territory of Puducherry for a continuous period of at least five years
Must be enrolled as a member of the Fishermen Co-operative Society
Must not have received Old Age Pension from the department
Must not be employed in Government, Government Undertakings, or Fishermen Co-operative Society
Must have no dues payable to the Department or Fishermen Co-operative Societies at the time of application
Must possess a registered mechanized boat
Must have insured the boat on an annual basis with an authorized insurance company
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy up to ₹20,000 per boat on the annual insurance premium.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
